Missing/malformed secrets fail before publishing partial config; serialized server config contains references and debug/errors omit values. Password bytes are preserved.

The owned UDP driver receives the explicit binding/range, one host-candidate NAT address and All/Relay policy. No new authority, replay identity, negotiated codec or readiness success is inferred from this configuration.
